msrv.policy: CI and package updates keep the workspace buildable on the declared MSRV; the current floor follows DataFusion 53.1.0 and kube 3.1.0.

package_reviews.subject: datafusion
package_reviews.feature_policy: Use DataFusion for ad hoc SQL and Parquet scans through Velorix query policy gates; do not make it durable authority.
package_reviews.replacement_plan: Upgrade through the DataFusion release train and keep DataFusion-version-specific policy evidence explicit.

package_reviews.subject: object_store
package_reviews.feature_policy: Use object_store for authoritative create/read/list/range behavior through Velorix capability probes; keep authority and DataFusion scan client boundaries explicit.
package_reviews.replacement_plan: Unify duplicate object_store versions when DataFusion and authority-path dependencies converge without weakening create-only semantics.

package_reviews.subject: kube
package_reviews.feature_policy: Use kube for Kubernetes coordination, CRDs, watch, and Lease APIs only; object storage remains database authority.
package_reviews.replacement_plan: Upgrade with the kube release train and keep generated CRD/Lease evidence current.

package_reviews.subject: k8s-openapi
package_reviews.feature_policy: Use the Kubernetes API version set selected by kube and CI; avoid hand-written Kubernetes wire types.
package_reviews.replacement_plan: Advance with kube compatibility requirements and regenerate CRD evidence when supported cluster APIs change.

package_reviews.subject: slatedb
package_reviews.feature_policy: Use SlateDB as the state substrate; do not duplicate its LSM, SST, compaction, cache, or retention internals.
package_reviews.replacement_plan: Upgrade through SlateDB releases and keep Velorix state refs/retention APIs at the SlateDB boundary.

package_reviews.subject: foyer
package_reviews.feature_policy: Use Foyer only as a non-authoritative cache; never use it as durable database state.
package_reviews.replacement_plan: Replace or disable Foyer if cache behavior conflicts with authority-path object storage or SlateDB ownership.

package_reviews.subject: feldera_artifacts
package_reviews.feature_policy: Treat Feldera/DBSP output as trusted only through Velorix artifact metadata, relation fingerprints, and release provenance gates.
package_reviews.replacement_plan: Keep direct execution disabled until artifact, state, resource, and recovery contracts are proven.
